title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Monday, 23 November 2026
description: A major bank warns businesses about increasingly convincing AI-enabled scams, Australia's foreign home-buyer ban stays a live point in the housing debate, Queensland's Tennis Centre Olympic upgrade moves into site investigations, and the Gold Coast Titans secure $25 million for a new Carrara training hub. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
